english: A horrid noise in the dark.
Moving. A mess of rusty iron and clattering bones.
Moving towards you.
No, no, no...
I hate the crypts...!
IT CALLS TO YOU.
Roll initiative.
Is that... a skeleton?
Incoming undead. It is set on killing you.
NO. SHIT.
Destroy it!
Don't you have some holy magic against this thing?
The goblin brings out his sling. In one swift move he launches a projectile towards the abomination.
It flies right through its open rib cage.
Taking stilted steps towards you, the skeleton raises its sword-hand.
The blade comes down, striking you in the shoulder.
A bone-chilling shriek emanates from the skull.
As the blade comes down, you sidestep it.
Good, don't let 'em hit you.
The skeleton flails around on the spot, clearly losing its focus after the miss.
You must defend yourself! And smite this foul abomination!
Be afraid. This is a warrior of old...
Too late to run away! But you gotta stay loose, or this thing'll cut you into pieces.
JOIN YOUR BROTHER.
The bones are outside of the body.
They must return.
Clearly, any type of piercing or slashing damage would be near useless against this creature.
Blunt force is what you need.
Blunt force? Your fists will lead the way.
Can't I just... tell it to stop?
Punch the skeleton.
Try to dodge.
Give him a hug.
Would hugging it help in any way?
Fucking how?
<shake>Skelepathically</shake>?!
Yeah. No. Talking ain't going to help you here.
Being friendly never hurts.
Your swing misses the skeleton completely, as it jitters back in an unnatural fashion.
As if it is animated by some foul punch-dodging force.
More or less.
Your feet. They dance.
Side to side - your eyes focused on the skeleton's blade.
You're ready for anything.
You attempt to move with the attacks, but you just end up stepping on your feet.
Nearly falling over. But not quite.
With rattling bones, you step forward. Your arms outstretched.
What are you doing? Get back!
It is TOO LATE.
As you grow closer to the skeleton, you find yourself unable to hold its increasingly jittering body language.
You cannot hold it still.
Wait...
You spot something strange. Maybe.
You cannot calm your brother.
With a quick lash, the skeleton manages to get loose from your grip, and in the process hits you in the helmet.
Sending your mind spinning.
YES.
NO.
This might be your last chance. The skeleton is growing more and more frantic.
What's happening? Are you losing?
Focus!
Letting go of his sling, the goblin instead goes in for a kick to the skele-shins.
While the creature is jittering about, Snell still manages to hit it - sending it scrambling to regain balance.
Now! Get him!
The skeleton gives off a deep hiss, as it again strikes at you.
This time, stabbing you right in the chest.
The mail stops it from reaching your heart.
The skeleton is off-balanced, and missing its next strike.
It flies past, inches from your face.
You'll have to push it further.
Fight!
It's useless. The bones are too strong...
Try to dodge.
Look for a weakness.
I'm trying!
And- you're the fucking cleric! Use your magic or something!
Uh-oh.
You look around the skeleton's scrap-covered bones as it wriggles around.
But alas. You cannot find some mystical weakness.
Not in this chaos.
Bones and iron stabilize in front of you. Focusing on its only task.
It hasn't been long, but now you realize the skeleton is getting its bearings.
By the gods, it's going to kill you.
This will be the end.
That's right... come here you piece of shit...
The goblin lines up a shot with his sling and mutters, "I've got you now."
Your last chance.
Take it or die. By Urth's valor.
Oh. By Urth.
You're dead.
Shut up. I've got this.
Bone. Against. BONE.
You quickly constrict your brother with your flesh-wrapped bones.
It squirms.
But it cannot leave your grip.
Holy shit, Cleric...!
Keep him like that!
Can you feel the brotherly love?!
Stop squirming!
(Hold him closer.)
The skeleton shrieks.
As it does, Snell starts kicking it. Over and over.
As bones break, the dust flying out across the chamber, the shriek fades.
Whatever evil animated this corpse seems to fade away, leaving only a husk in your bosom.
DE-ANIMATED.
There we go, finally... he mumbles, taking heavy breaths.
(Let go.)
The foe has been vanquished.
Death through love.
Ballsy move. But quick thinking.
There!
As you move around it, you spot an arrowhead jammed into its spinal cord.
You glance to the goblin, who gives you an erratic nod.
Go!
(Pull it out.)
With a single tug...
You watch as the structure of this bony apparition completely collapses.
As the thing's shriek fades, rib cage and skull fall into itself.
You focus intense necrotic energy into your fist.
The necrotic damage won't actually do much to the undead.
But the punch will.
With a single swing you line up a perfect strike.
Your fist connects with the thing's skull, cutting off its horrid shriek.
The impact sends its skull flying off- as the rest of it collapses upon the crypt floor.
Great hit!
You speak the words of your god. The sacred power flows through them, through you.
And the horrid shriek of the skeleton intensifies - until it turns and runs.
Begone, abomination!
As if looking for a way out in a state of panic, the thing scrambles in multiple directions.
Unfortunately, those directions conflict with one another, which causes the bones to break apart on the spot.
That's what I'm talking about!
He gives you a tap on the back. "Cleric magic!"
The skeleton is just about to strike when Snell rushes its legs - a full body slam.
He causes the thing to completely fall over, crashing onto the hard ground.
Hah! That's what you get!
The skeleton lines up a strike. You see it coming.
As if time itself slows down, just for your final moment, you watch as the rusted blade perfectly strikes at...
The bones spill to the ground in a pile of dust and scrap metal.
No other threats?
No. None.
No other threats. This skeleton must have been the only guardian.
You're welcome.
You did... good too.
You've performed your duty. This crypt has been cleansed.
That's an overstatement.
Why do you put yourself in these situations...?
The goblin leans on his knees, panting.
Gods. I hate crypts.
He raises a finger and wags it. "Nothing good ever came from constructing a crypt."
You either get a cursed place filled with death, or a meat grinder filled with undeath.
His veins are nothing but adrenaline.
Are you insane? Look at this place, it's like-
Really, a genuinely smart tradition.
Best thing humans ever invented.
Actually, I think it was a dwarven thing originally.
Oh yes. For sure.
Oh.
Well, it was smart to adopt it. Or at the very least, it-
A bang from somewhere far away echoes down the hallway.
The goblin jumps.
A shiver down your spine.
Then the chamber grows silent once more. A scent of death still lingers.
He clears his throat. "Fuck this place. Let's go."
Let's see what kind of loot we get...
This was a great warrior in his time.
You have honored him with one final fight.
(Say a prayer to Urth.)
(Just focus on looting the corpse.)
(Do something in-between grave-robbing and religion.)
(Be apolitical.)
You do so.
Hells yeah.
You will have to consider where on the spectrum your actions will land.
Good choice. Proud of you.
E-...Right.
Which is?
Some respect. (Whisper a prayer to Urth.)
A good old-fashioned looting.
I'm not sure. But he looks like he used to be a real warrior of Urth. So...
Right. I get it.
E-I'll do what I must.
